column1: # Bosses take turns by wave in row order (wave 1 = first row), then repeat with more HP. 15 Oct 2026: every boss
# was the same fight ("very the same shit over and over") and it killed Corne in all three of his runs.
# hp = (boss_base_hp + boss_hp_per_wave * wave) * hp_mult. speed: m/s toward the player (+ boss_speed_bonus_at_zero_hp
# as it loses health). steer: m/s sideways toward the player's x. contact_dx / contact_damage: how wide it hits, how hard.
# hold_z: stops this far ahead of the player and fights from there (0 = charges through). hold_seconds: then it
# runs out of patience and charges (a bot farmed a Summoner for 20 minutes on 15 Oct). strafe: metres it slides
# side to side while holding (0 = none). summon_*: calls summon_count summon_enemy every summon_every s (0 = never).
# shoot_*: fires one slow shot at where you are every shoot_every s (0 = never); you dodge it.
# The first row's numbers are the old single boss (Boss.ts + plan D13).
